case_d_c4_unit.actual_event: Popcorn polymer grew in a dead leg (no-flow branch) of butadiene piping, ruptured the pipe; released butadiene ignited.

case_e_fcc_shutdown.actual_event: Eroded spent-catalyst slide valve could not hold a seal as catalyst was withdrawn; air mixed with hydrocarbons; explosion; debris punctured asphalt tank.

case_f_pulp_mill_area.source: CSB, Packaging Corporation of America DeRidder (2017)
case_f_pulp_mill_area.actual_event: Hot work on piping above a foul condensate tank ignited flammable vapour (turpentine/methanol) in the tank system; tank exploded; three contractors killed.

case_g_batch_plant.actual_event: Incompatible material (KOH emulsifier) charged into a tank with Si-H fluid generated hydrogen, which accumulated in the building and ignited; four killed.

case_h_corn_mill.actual_event: Combustible dust explosion began in milling equipment and propagated through connected equipment and the building (secondary explosions); five killed.
